coupling: The first edit marks quick-check RegExpShared objects with more than ten capture pairs using internal flag bit 1; alone, that bit has no consumer. The second edit treats that bit as a compact capture-output mode, allocates only half as many MatchPair elements, then restores the full pair count reported to irregexp. Alone, the second edit cannot enter this mode because the original quick-check setter never sets bit 1. Together, a successful match with many captures writes its full result into the undersized buffer.
